result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main visual/logic defect is that the 'Pizza' filter chip is shown as selected, yet the displayed content is not filtered to pizza restaurants (ramen bar, burger joints, poké bowls are shown). A couple of minor cosmetic observations were also noted.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category filter chip is in the selected/active state, but the listed restaurants do not match the filter: 'Fastest near you' shows Green Bowl Poké and Smash Bros Burgers, and 'Popular right now' features Tokumaru Ramen Bar. Only one partially visible pizza card appears at the bottom.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant lists actually filter by the selected category, or reset the chip to 'All' if the content is unfiltered, so the UI state matches the displayed results.

issues.description: Inconsistent presentation of delivery fee info: cards in 'Fastest near you' show it as plain text ('€0.90 delivery'), while 'Popular right now' cards use an overlaid badge ('€0 delivery') plus repeated text in the meta row, creating slight redundancy and inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize how delivery fees are displayed across sections (either badge or meta text) and avoid duplicating the same information within one card.
